title: Cities Skylines | Franklin, Episode 4: Revolution
premise: While building Fort Montresor, the presenter argues that the American Revolution largely replaced governing elites without transforming class relations; ICE preamble and grotesque Cambodia satire frame an anti-tyranny refrain.
coverage: Read all34 ASR segments and all360 canonical frames:357 original frames on30 contact sheets plus3 authorized supplemental one-tile sheets. Original sampling every5seconds plus scene score>0.30 at480px. Native stills read226.960,464.965,634.968,721.550,727.530,812.700,1039.000,1145.000; supplemental canonical frames read721.554,727.560,812.712. Compared episode3 sheet0012 for founder callback. Full dialogue is source-derived by renderer from every transcript word, not authored excerpts. Boundaries group narrative/image changes, not certified shot onsets. University affiliation is intentionally black-bar censored. Historical claims attributed to presenter; ASR names and photo associations uncertain where noted. Soundtrack not directly auditioned: sound[] means unannotated, not silence. Sparse frames can miss brief visual/audiovisual gags.
